translations.text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard and have seen with our eyes, which we saw, and our hands ministered to the word of life.
And the life was revealed, and we have seen it, and we bear witness and declare to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and was revealed to us;
what we have heard and seen we declare to you, so that you too may have fellowship with us; and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
And I write this to you so that our joy may be complete.
And this is the promise which we heard from him and declare to you: that God is light, and in him there is no darkness, not any at all.
If we say that we have fellowship with him while we walk in darkness, we lie and do not do the truth.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous, so that he will forgive us our sins and cleanse us from all falsehood.
If we say that we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar, and his word is not in us.
My children, I write this to you so that you may not sin; and if anyone does sin, we have a comforter with the Father, Christ Jesus the righteous.
And he is the forgiver of our sins, and not of our sins only, but of the sins of the whole world.
And by this we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
Whoever says, "I have known him," and does not keep his commandments is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
But whoever keeps his words, truly the love of God has been made perfect in him. By this we know that we are in him.
Whoever says that he abides in him ought to walk just as he himself walked.
Brothers, I am not writing a new commandment to you, but the old commandment, which you have had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
Again, I am writing a new commandment to you, which is true in him and among you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light is already appearing.
Whoever says he is in the light and hates his brother is in darkness even until now.
But whoever loves his brother is in the light, and there is no stumbling in him.
But whoever hates his brother is in darkness and walks in darkness, and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
I am writing to you, children, because your sins are forgiven you through his name.

I am writing to you, fathers, because you have known him who was first. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I am writing to you, little children, because you have known the Father.

I have written to you, fathers, because you have known him who was first. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
Do not love this world, nor anything that belongs to this world. If anyone loves this world, the love of the Father is not in him.
For everything in the world is this: the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the arrogance of this life. And this is not from the Father, but is from the world.
And this world will pass away, and its desire too; but whoever does the will of God will remain forever.
Children, it is the last hour. As you have heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now there are many antichrists; from this we know that it is the last hour.
They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have remained with us. But they went out so that it might be made plain that not all of them are of us.
And you too have life from the Holy One, and you know all things.
I have not written to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is from the truth.
Who is the liar? Is it not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, the one who denies the Father and the Son.
No one who denies the Son has the Father with him either.
As for you, then, let what you heard from the beginning remain with you. If what you heard from the beginning remains with you, you too will remain with the Son and the Father.
And this is the promise that he promised us: eternal life.
I have written these things to you about those who are deceiving you.

And as for you, the anointing that you received from him remains with you, and you have no need for anyone to teach you. Instead, that same anointing teaches you about all things. It is true and it is not a lie; and just as it has taught you, remain in him.
And now, children, remain in him, so that when he appears we may have boldness and not be put to shame before him at his coming.
If you know that he is righteous, know also that everyone who does what is right is born of him.
See what great love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God. This is why the world does not know you: because it did not know him either.
Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. But we know that when he appears we will be like him, for we will see him as he is.
And everyone who has this hope in him purifies himself, just as he is pure.
Everyone who commits sin also commits lawlessness; sin is lawlessness.
And you know that he appeared in order to take away our sins, and in him there is no sin.
No one who remains in him sins, and no one who sins has seen him or known him.
Children, let no one deceive you. The one who does what is right is righteous, just as he himself is righteous.
The one who commits sin is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The Son of God was revealed for this reason: to destroy the works of the devil.
No one who is born of God commits sin, because his seed remains in him. He cannot sin, because he is born of God.
By this the children of God and the children of the devil are made plain: no one who does not do what is right is of God, and neither is anyone who does not love his brother.
For this is the promise that you have heard from the beginning: that we should love one another.
Not like Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. And why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, but his brother's were righteous.
Do not be surprised, my brothers, that the world hates you.
We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love the brothers. Whoever does not love his brother remains in death.
Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
By this we shall know his love: that he laid down his life for us. And we too ought to give the glory [?] of our lives for the brothers.
If anyone has the goods of this world and sees his brother in some need, and shuts his heart against him, how does the love of God remain in him?
My children, let us not love only with word or with tongue, but in deed and in truth.
And by this we shall be known, that we are of the truth, and our hearts will be assured before him.
For if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart and knows all things.
Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have boldness before God.
And whatever we ask, we shall receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do what is pleasing before him.
And this is his commandment: that we believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as he gave us the commandment.
And whoever keeps his commandments remains in him, and he himself in him. And by this we know that he remains in us: by the Spirit which he gave us.
Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are from God, for many false prophets have gone out into the world.
By this you shall know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ come in the flesh is from God;
and every spirit that does not confess Jesus Christ come in the flesh is not from God. And this is of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that he is to come, and now he is already in the world.
You are from God, children, and you have overcome them; for he who is in you is greater than he who is of the world.
They are of the world; therefore they speak of the world, and the world listens to them.
We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us, and whoever is not from God does not listen to us. By this we shall know the spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
Beloved, let us love one another, for love is from God, and everyone who loves is born of God and knows God.
Whoever does not love does not know God, for God is of love.
By this the love of God was revealed among us: that God sent his only-begotten Son into the world, so that we might live through him.
And this is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as the propitiation for our sins.
Beloved, if God loved us so, we too ought to love one another.
No one has ever seen God. If we love one another, God abides in us, and his love is perfected in us.
By this we know that we abide in him and he in us: because he has given us of his Spirit.
And we have seen and we testify that the Father sent the Son as Savior of the world.
Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him and he in God.
And we have come to know and have believed the love that God has toward us. God is love, and whoever remains in love, God abides in him and he in God.
By this love is perfected among us, so that we may have boldness on the day of judgment, because just as he was, so are we also in this world.
There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear has torment, and the one who fears is not perfect in love.
We love him because he first loved us.
If anyone says, "I love God," and hates his brother, he is a liar; for whoever does not love his brother, whom he has seen, how can he love God, whom he has not seen?
And this commandment we have received from him: that whoever loves God should love his brother also.
Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves the parent loves also the one born of him.
By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep his commandments.
For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments; and his commandments are not heavy.
For everything that is born of God overcomes the world; and this is the victory by which our faith overcomes the world.
What is it by which one overcomes the world, if not that one believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and by blood also. And it is the Spirit that testifies, because the Spirit is of truth.
For there are three that testify: the Spirit and the water and the blood, and these three are directed toward one.
If we receive the testimony of men, the testimony of God is greater; for this is the testimony of God, which he testified concerning his Son.

Whoever believes in the Son of God has that testimony within himself; whoever does not believe God has made him out to be a liar, because he has not believed the testimony that God testified concerning his Son.
And this is the testimony: that God has given us eternal life, and this life is with his Son.
Whoever has the Son has life also. Whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life either.
I have written this to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life, so that you may believe in the name of the Son of God.
And this is the boldness that I have toward him: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.
Whatever we ask, we also know that we shall receive the request that we have asked of him.

If anyone sees his brother committing a sin that is not unto death, let him ask, and He will give him life — that is, to those who sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death; I do not say that he should ask concerning that.
All falsehood is sin, and there is sin that is not unto death.
We know that everyone who has been born of God does not sin; rather, the one who has been born of God keeps himself, and the evil one does not touch him.
We know that we are of God, and the whole world rests upon the evil one.

And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know the true God; and we are with the True One, with his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
Children, guard yourselves from idols. Amen.
